name: CA-47
label: Safe D

key_factors: Markets price Min at 97% to win
Min holds a large cash advantage ($1.9M vs $129K)
District leans Democratic by 6 points with a favorable national environment
First-term incumbent with no polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: Prediction markets on both Kalshi and Polymarket price Min at 97%, and his fundraising and cash-on-hand advantage dwarfs Le Roux's. The district's Democratic lean and incumbency support a comfortable win, so the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any late surge in outside spending against Min or a polling surprise showing the race inside single digits would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Dave Min, a first-term Democratic incumbent, defends a coastal Orange County district that leans Democratic by about six points. He has raised $3.4 million and holds $1.9 million on hand, while Republican Jenny Le Roux has raised under $400,000 with minimal outside support. No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the picture rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Both Kalshi and Polymarket give Min roughly a 97% chance of winning, consistent with the district's lean, the incumbency advantage, and the lopsided financial gap. The forecast expects a comfortable Democratic margin with moderate uncertainty, since the seat is newly held and polling is absent.
